champion.builds: THE BEST JHIN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Jhin Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Dark Harvest as your keystone, followed by Taste of Blood, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Coup de Grace and Presence of Mind in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Bloodsong as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Umbral Glaive. For your last 3 items, you should build The Collector, Rapid Firecannon and finish with Infinity Edge. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 42.9% winrate over 219 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Fleet Footwork as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Celerity with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Bloodsong as your first item, then Boots of Swiftness as a second item and Umbral Glaive as a third item. You want to finish the build with The Collector, Rapid Firecannon and Infinity Edge. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 41.1% win rate across 56 matches played. Situational Jhin Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Jhin build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Jhin runes page.
